description: Per-repo Renovate config, processed by the maintainer's self-hosted runner.
hassette-client is pinned twice: in manifest.json (what HA installs) and in the test dependency group (what CI tests). One grouped PR bumps both; tests/test_manifest.py fails if they drift.
The HA-floor CI job pins its own pytest-homeassistant-custom-component in tests.yml, outside Renovate's reach on purpose: the floor moves only when the code needs a newer HA, together with hacs.json.

packageRules.description: A client bump changes what users install, so it is a fix that release-please releases.
Dev and CI dependencies don't reach users and stay out of the changelog.
